you_should_know.title: New contract allows ICE to use empty western Minnesota prison to hold detainees
you_should_know.summary: As Minnesota continues to feel the aftershock of a federal immigration surge that sparked protests, traumatized families, devastated businesses and left two of its residents dead, the Department of Homeland Security is set to expand its presence in the state by contracting an empty prison in western Minnesota (the rural part of the state along the South Dakota border) for ICE to hold detainees.
